items.title: John Batiste "Bat" Stecklet Interview, 1959-06-15
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Yeah, you tell Mr. Russell, or another, have it on here. I'd like to hear about it too.

ctx.x: Well, they just played parties, you understand? Parties, yeah. Mm-hmm. Now in 1998 they had a lot of flag raisins. I don't know if that, if they took that on in the north, or in the east, or even in the west, like they did here in the city of New Orleans. But right after the Spanish-American War, man, there was flag raisins. I believe I told you about that, didn't I?
Yeah, you tell Mr. Russell, or another, have it on here. I'd like to hear about it too.
I thought about the flag raisin, because you put it on that tape back. Yeah. Tell Mr. Russell about the flag raisin when you told us.
